_authoring.purpose: AI reactions to becoming a Milk Maid or receiving a milk-related curse.
_authoring.player_controls: How discovery, transformation and curse outcomes are described.
_authoring.contains: Separate conversion, existing-maid curse, chest curse and event-context text.
_authoring.perspective: The affected character owns the change; player reaction routes use private self-comments.
_authoring.boundary: A curse affecting an existing Milk Maid is not another conversion. Text does not cause conversion.

_help: Edit template text or replace a template with a string array. Keep the documented placeholders. Use MCM Reload Narration JSON after saving.

narrate_milkmaid_created_1.template: {actor} стал дояркой и теперь может производить молоко. Отреагируйте своим собственным голосом на обнаружение этой способности.

_authoring.intent: Have a newly created Milk Maid react to discovering that she can produce milk.

narrate_forced_milk_maid_conversion_1.template: {conversion} Реагирует на преобразование как {actor}. Его причина не установлена; не придумывайте напиток.

_authoring.intent: Have the affected character react to her reported transformation without inventing how it happened.

milkmaidCreatedMessage.template: {actor} стал дояркой! Ее грудь теперь кажется приятно тяжелой, полной и слегка волнующей.

_authoring.format: Narration. Background or event context used by AI-generated narration.
_authoring.intent: Inform Skyrim.Net that the named character has become a Milk Maid.

narrate_milk_maid_curse_1.template: {conversion} Реагирует как существующая доярка {actor} на добавленное молоко. Это не новое обращение или напиток.

_authoring.intent: Have an existing Milk Maid react to a curse adding milk to her breasts; this is not another conversion.

narrate_chest_milk_maid_curse_1.template: Проклятие {chest_kind} затронуло {actor}. {outcome} Реагируйте как {actor} на чары сундука. Добавлено молоко: {milk_added}; не цитируйте цифры и не придумывайте выпивку, добычу или другое преобразование.

_authoring.intent: Have the affected character react to the reported chest curse and its actual outcome.
